heading: Like-for-like revenue across the four comparable branches increased by +2.8%, up +3.5M to 125.4M.
paragraphs: Like-for-like revenue is ahead by +2.8%, with sales up +3.5M versus the prior period.
The four comparable branches delivered 125.4M in revenue versus 122.0M last year.
This summary shows revenue only, so basket, pricing and transactions evidence is not available here to show what supported the increase.
The figures cover the comparable branch population only: CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021.
Review the same comparable branch group alongside transactions, quantity, average price per item and quantity per transaction to confirm what supported the +2.8% revenue increase.
Compare the +3.5M uplift by branch within the comparable population to see which stores contributed most to the overall result.
Monitor the current period coverage because the reporting month is June 2026 and the final month can be incomplete.
